empty-description: Install a presence from the library.
language-description: Use your browser's language by default, or choose a specific language for Nowly.
display-description: Choose how presences are organized in the list.
separate-active-description: Hides the active presence from the list.
api-base-url-description: Override the default API URL for self-hosted instances.
onboarding-user-scripts-gate-body: Nowly uses user scripts to run presences on supported websites. This is how the extension detects what you are watching or listening to, then prepares your Discord activity.
onboarding-user-scripts-gate-privacy: Installed presences are signed and verified locally before they run. Nowly does not store personal data for this step and only sends the minimum required information to the local client.
onboarding-native-gate-body: The client is a small local app that connects the extension to Discord Rich Presence. Without it, the browser cannot send your activity to Discord.
onboarding-native-gate-privacy: The client only receives the activity information needed for Discord display. Nowly does not store your personal data for this connection.
onboarding-native-gate-wait: Have you installed the client? Wait until this indicator turns blue to continue.
onboarding-tour-activity-body: This area shows the presence currently detected and sent to Discord when everything is connected.
onboarding-tour-library-body: Install new presences from the library, then come back here to manage them.
onboarding-tour-presences-body: Enable, disable, configure, or remove each installed presence from the list.
onboarding-tour-settings-body: Find language, display, updates, the native client, and diagnostics in settings.
analytics-description: Share anonymous technical stats to help improve presences, reliability, and install flows. Titles, URLs, searches, watched content, and Discord IDs are never sent.
onboarding-analytics-help: Would you like to help us improve Nowly?
onboarding-analytics-delete: You can withdraw at any time.
snooze-description: Temporarily pause sending activity to Discord.
schedule-description: Set days and times when this presence can show on Discord.
schedule-feature-description: Show schedule buttons on presences and in the action bar.
